question: Can an explicit two-part code comparison distinguish message-bearing, numeric-only and mixed synthetic production without mistaking copying for absence of text?
text_family: A-Z letters encrypted by one affine bijection modulo26, emitted as decimal pairs00..25. Enumerate all312keys. A fixed external English letter-bigram model with alpha0.5; mass15/16on valid pairs, mass1/16uniformly distributed over74escaped pairs26..99. Escapes reset letter context. Odd terminal digit paid uniformly. Not arbitrary substitution, homophony, unit codes or all possible English.
copy_facility: Both text and numeric models may use the same dictionary fitted ONLY on discovery. Existing deterministic greedy coverage at pair lengths4,8,12,16,24,32; maximum64entries. Pair alphabet00..99, encoded7bits each in the dictionary. Exact shortest-path parse, literal flag+arithmetic pair or reference flag+fixedwidth index. Context updates through all recovered digits including references. No dictionary adaptation on held data.
mixed_family: One text configuration and one numeric configuration; each document carries one paid route bit and uses the cheaper component. Both components fit only discovery. This is a description of mixture, not an assertion that route bits are predicted before seeing a document.
cost_accounting: Gamma(length+1) and2arithmetic termination bits perdocument; gamma counts for document numbers.2bits for T/N/Mclass. Text key9bits, copyflag1, English counts26+676serialized by gamma(count+1). Numeric base2bits, copyflag1, IID10orMarkov110counts gamma-coded. Mixed key9, base2, two copyflags and route1perdocument. Shared dictionary charged once when used. Common decoder source bytes of round29_models.py and generative_comparison.py charged8bits/byte plus gamma(bytecount+1), equally to all classes. Python/numpy interpreter and decoding language assumed shared. No fitted seed: seed cost0; fixture seeds generate controls only and never decode data. Cuts, exceptions and copied payloads are paid by length, escape and reference codes. These are explicit ideal code lengths, not machine-independent Kolmogorov minima or measured compressed bytes.
selection: Exhaust all624text configurations,6numeric configurations and3744mixed combinations, using parameter+discovery data cost only. Then compare frozen component models by total two-part cost and separately held-data cost. T,N,M fixed tie order. Never select a key/dictionary from held data.

fixtures.windows: Nonoverlapping normalized-letter windows, starting10000and advancing needed_letters+1024, alternating authors. Same30windows and document sizes paired across8profiles, not240independent source samples.
fixtures.lengths: 70book digit lengths, each rounded DOWN to an even number for synthetic paired encodings; original lengths recorded. First50synthetic documents discovery, last20reserved. Real corpus kept unchanged.

profiles.text_affine: T: fresh natural prose encrypted by a sampled affine key
profiles.text_copied: T: sampled32letter modules from the same source window,16discovery modules and8additional novel modules available in held data; assembly is message-bearing fragments, not necessarily a coherent essay
profiles.numeric_shuffled_modules: N: same module identities and assembly as copied English, but each module's letter order shuffled once before encoding; preserves per-module histograms and repeat structure, removes supplied ordered plaintext
profiles.mixed: M: alternate complete prose ciphertext and numericMarkov documents; no fitted source labels supplied
profiles.text_permutation_challenge: T: same natural prose but a non-affine arbitrary permutation of26letter symbols; outside textual search family
profiles.copied_permutation_challenge: T: same copied English through that arbitrary permutation; outside textual search family

gate.general_application: Require27/30correct for EACH of8profiles separately for the relevant rule; no pooling successes across profiles or authors. Report six in-family profiles separately. Even passing does not authenticate game authorship or qualify untested cipher families.
gate.failed_gate_action: Do not apply T/N/Morigin labels or compare game model costs as origin evidence. Perform corpus/source copy audit only, preserve inconclusive mission state. No threshold retuning or additional family search in this round.

dependence_audit: Report exact12and24digit window overlap for every synthetic train/held pair. For exposed real corpus, reproduce12digit book connected components and first50/last20coverage, and all occurrences of priority-source groups length>=12inbooks. Do not turn connected copies into independent evidence or select a new split to improve a result.
translation_rule: No candidate plaintext from a compressor win. A real translation still needs one fixed decoder, coherent unseen English, dependency audit and external attestation. No authenticated original game generator is available.
runtime_rule: Complete finite searches; stop and report any incomplete fits rather than truncate or change the gate. No target-origin search if gate fails.
